say: Brother, I'm no heretic. I said one wrong thing at the wrong table, that's all.
Okran sees every cell. He must be looking elsewhere.
I have recanted twice. They want a third that I mean.
Don't speak to me where the paladins can see.
I have prayed until my knees bled. The light doesn't come through stone.
They call it penance. I call it being forgotten slowly.
I only wanted to know what became of my brother.
If you serve the light, say a verse for me. I have forgotten them all.
You hold a child of Okran in a cage. Count that against yourself when the light comes.
Give me to the Inquisitorium and I'll speak kindly of you. Keep me, and I won't.
Whatever you want from the Holy Nation, I can't give it. I'm nobody. That's why I'm here.
Kill me and I'm a martyr. Free me and I'm a witness. Do neither and I'm a nuisance.
I forgive you. It's easy. I have been practising on the guards.
You're no paladin. Paladins at least pretend the keys are holy.
Brother! Say my name at the gate. Only once.
Pray for me. Pray loudly. Someone important might hear.
Don't look at me. Look at the paladins. They're the ones who decide.
A little water, a little mercy. Either one will do.
Whoever you are, you walk. I envy the walking.
Is that the light on your face, or only the torches?
Dark one. Even in chains I'm cleaner than you.
Okran will burn the door off my cell, and then he will find you.
Look at me, beast. Look at what the light does to its own. Imagine what it does to you.
Take your eyes off me. I won't be tainted by being looked at.
I pray you hang from your own chains, stranger.
The light is patient, heretic. It can wait for you as long as it likes.
Quietly. The paladins pass this corridor at every bell.
Okran guide your hands. And please, hurry them.
Faster. Faster. I hear boots.
There is a trick to that lock. No. I do not know it. Keep going.
Don't stop. Don't look back. Don't tell me if someone is coming.
Yes. Yes, that's how the light must feel.
Okran be praised. And you, whoever you are.
I am free. I am free and I am a criminal. I will think about that later.
Run. I'll follow as I can. Don't wait for a sinner.
The light let me out through your hands.
You have broken a holy lock. They'll call it a holy crime.
Don't tell me your name. I wouldn't be able to lie about it.
You free me? Why? Is this a test of faith?
I'll remember this, stranger. All of it.
Do you think a chain is the worst thing that happened to me here? Go on.
I'll tell the Inquisitorium how you treated me. I'll tell it kindly.
Free to go? Free to be caught by someone else.
Is this a trick? Don't answer.
I'll pray for you. Quickly, before I think better of it.
Don't follow me. Don't even watch.
Not a dream. Still the stone.
Brother? No. Only the wall.
I dreamed of the fields. The light was warm there.
My head. What did they hit me with? Never mind.
Awake again. I thought sleep would be a mercy, but it keeps ending.
Why heal what you mean to keep? Never mind.
Mercy from a jailer. Okran, you have a sense of humour.
A mended prisoner lasts longer. I understand the arithmetic.
I won't thank you. I'll pray for you.
You heal a heretic, brother. Is that allowed? It feels allowed.
The light thanks you, and so do I.
Strange, being touched without being struck.
Go carefully. Mercy is a crime in some corridors.
Okran have mercy. I recanted. I recanted everything.
Not me. I was only singing. Singing isn't a sin.
They are coming with the prayer again. It is not a prayer I like.
Let it be quick. Let it be holy. Let it be soon. No.
A Shek in a coop. Look, /FLATSKIN/. Enjoy the sight, it won't last.
Unlock this and I will not remember your face. Leave it and I will remember it forever.
It took six of them to hold me. Count that when you tell it.
I won't beg. I'll wait. The difference is a Shek's whole life.
Honour is hard to keep in a cage. I keep it anyway.
Are you here to gawk, /FLATSKIN/? Gawk quickly.
This is no death for a warrior. Open the door and let it be a better one.
Go on. Ask me what I want. I want my spear and your absence.
Hold me or kill me, /FLATSKIN/.
You chain a Shek and call it victory. Bring it to my kin and see what they call it.
I won't bargain. If my kin pay, they pay. If they don't, I die as I am.
One day this cage will be a story. I'll tell it, and you'll be the fool in it.
Spit on you? I would, but I won't waste water.
A Shek doesn't ask. A Shek waits for the right moment to stop waiting.
You have the key. You also have the fear.
You. Flatskin. Walk on. A Shek in a cage is no sight for you.
I don't beg. I say: open it, once, and with respect.
If you fear my kin, free me. If you don't, free me also.
Walk past if you must. Remember that I was standing.
Even through bars I can count how many of you there are.
A stranger. Have you a blade? Even a poor one? No? Then walk on.
Come close, /FLATSKIN/. The bars are thin where it matters.
Every night I dream your neck. Every morning it's still unbroken.
When I'm out, you'll know it by the silence.
Bring your friends. I'll use them to climb out.
I know your face now. A Shek forgets nothing.
Coward. You hit me when I was alone. Hit me again.
Don't tremble, /FLATSKIN/. A lock is only a small enemy.
Slow hands. A good lock is a patient enemy.
I hear them coming. Or I hear my pulse.
If you fail, I won't blame you. I'll only die disappointed.
Yes. That's the click. Again.
Don't look at me. Look at the lock. I'm not the one who needs killing.
You have my gratitude. Don't mistake that for friendship.
I'm in your debt, /FLATSKIN/. A Shek counts debts exactly.
Freedom. Good. Now I find my spear.
You did it without being asked. I'll remember that kindly.
Go. My kin will hear of what you did, and they'll be fair.
I thought I'd die in there. Instead I'll die later, and more loudly.
You release me? You are either a fool or a better warrior than you look.
I'll be back for your head. That isn't a threat.
To cage a Shek is foolishness. To free one is worse.
I don't thank captors. I outlive them.
Free? Hm. I'll remember the door, the hour, and your face.
I won't run. I'll walk quickly, with dignity.
My thanks to the lock. Not to you.
Don't mistake an open door for mercy. It's only a door.
Stone. Bars. A bad dream that refuses to end.
Who struck me? Show me their face and I'll thank them with my fist.
I'm awake. That's the worst news yet.
My head. They hit well. Remember that.
The roof is low. A Shek should wake under open sky.
Why mend what you mean to break? Keep your hands from my face.
I didn't ask. I won't thank. I'll simply not kill you today.
A healthy prisoner is a better trade.
The wound closes. The insult doesn't.
You help a caged Shek. Good. Gratitude.
Hm. Your hands are not clumsy. Gratitude, /FLATSKIN/.
Quiet kindness is rare among your kind.
I didn't fall that badly. But I thank you.
ARGH! Do it properly, cowards!
ARGH! I don't scream! This is... NGH...
NGH! Is that all! IS THAT ALL!
Shek don't cry out. Shek announce!
I'm locked in. I'd like to be unlocked.
Hello. I'm a prisoner. This isn't a joke. I don't know jokes.
They wish to open me and see what I am. I'm a skeleton. That's what I am.
My joints are cold. The cage is damp. I don't recommend it.
Please don't leave. I'll wait. I'm good at waiting.
You can open this? Please do. I'll remember who did.
Tell the others I didn't run.
You're my captor. I register that. I don't like it.
If you wish to sell me for parts, do it quickly. If not, stop looking at my arm.
You hold me and I hold nothing. That's an uneven arrangement.
I don't bargain well. I have only the one thing, and you already have it.
Release me and I won't follow. I give my word. It's a short word.
You may break me. You may not make me say I'm sorry. I'm not.
Human. I'm in a cage.
Please take out a lock pick and use it.
I'm not dangerous. I'm only inconvenient.
You look at me. Do not look.
I don't fear the cold. I fear the bolt cutters.
Others walked by. You're the first who looked.
Human. You stand outside my cage. I'll remember where you stand.
When I'm free I'll find you. I don't forget. I wasn't built to.
You made a mistake. Nobody has told you yet.
I'm not afraid. I have nothing left to be afraid with.
Strike the bars. See which one breaks first.
Yes. Turn it. A little more.
Do not force it. The lock is old. So am I.
I hear no one. That isn't the same as no one.
Continue. I am not worried. I am only waiting.
Careful with the pick. It's the only one we have.
Thank you. I have no pay. I have a long memory.
Open. Good. I'll walk now.
You did that for no reason. I'll think about why.
I owe you. I won't forget the amount.
Goodbye. I mean it as a kindness.
I won't be caged twice.
You let me go. That was an error. I won't correct it for you.
Releasing me doesn't undo the key.
Run. That's my advice. It's free.
Let me go. I will go.
Release accepted. Goodbye.
I do not understand why. I am leaving before you understand it.
Thank you. I won't use that word again.
Systems restored. The cage is still here.
I'm online. Unfortunately.
Dark. Cold. Bars. Awake.
I had a dream. Then I remembered I don't dream.
Joints stiff. Head clear. Situation unchanged.
You repair what you hold. This is a good habit. Please continue, then let me go.
Repairs complete. Thank you. This doesn't change what you are.
My arm works. I won't use it on you.
I'm functional. I understand why you wanted me functional.
Repairs accepted. I have nothing to pay with but notice.
You fixed me. I didn't ask.
That was kind. I'll log it.
I'm whole enough. Thank you, human.
Don't remove that panel.
Careful. That part is difficult to replace.
Fine. Proceed. Don't drop anything inside me.
I'm leaking. I've been leaking for days.
They're coming. I assume it's for disassembly.
I'm next. I see it. I don't like it.
I don't want to be taken apart. This is an unusual thing to say.
Please. Unlock. Please.
Stop. Stop. This isn't useful information.
*screech* Stop. Please stop.
No more. There's nothing more in me.
*buzz* I've told you. I don't know.

packages: Npc Hiver (World State- Queen is dead)

say: We're caught. The cage is for one, but we're many.
The Hive is far. Our heads are quiet. We don't like quiet.
Please, /RACENAMEHIVE/. Free us. We work well. We work without rest.
We don't understand why we're in here. We did the work. We carried what we were given.
Don't hurt us. We don't know how to hurt back.
We count the bars. There are many. We stop counting. We start again.

packages: Npc Hiver (World State- Queen is dead)

say: You hold us. We feel it. We aren't angry.
The Hive will wonder where we are. The Hive wonders about everyone. It's its way.
Release us and we'll carry for you. We're good at carrying.
We won't fight. We don't understand fighting. We're sorry for that.
You're the one with the key. We're the ones with the time.
We don't know your name. We'll call you the one who kept us.

packages: Npc Hiver (World State- Queen is dead)

say: /RACENAMEHIVE/. Please. We're in a small place.
Don't walk past. Please. Walk here.
We make no noise. We are good at making no noise. Please.
You are not Hive. You are not hunters. You are something kinder.
Free us. We won't forget. We forget little. It's how we're made.
Others went by. None stopped. You have stopped.

packages: Npc Hiver (World State- Queen is dead)

say: Yes. Yes. That's how it opens.
Quiet. Quiet. The loud ones will come.
We help. We press our hands to the bars. It isn't enough.
It's nearly open. We can feel it. We're afraid to hope.
Hurry. Please. We aren't good at being still.

packages: Npc Hiver (World State- Queen is dead)

say: Free. We're free. We didn't think of free. We thought only of work.
Thank you, /RACENAMEHIVE/. We will tell the others. There are few others.
Open. We go now. We go quietly. Thank you.
We'll find the Hive. Or the Hive will find us. We don't mind which.
You gave us air. We are not used to it.

packages: Npc Hiver (World State- Queen is dead)

say: Free? You free us? After the cage?
We don't understand. You kept. Now you let go.
We'll go. We won't look back. We'll look back once.
Thank you. We're confused. We're grateful and confused.

packages: Npc Hiver (World State- Queen is dead)

say: We wake. The cage is the same. The cage is always the same.
Dark. Small. We're still here.
We dreamed of the Hive. We didn't hear it.
Our heads hurt. The pain is ours alone.

packages: Npc Hiver (World State- Queen is dead)

say: We're mended. Why? We don't know. We're grateful all the same.
The pain is small now. We can work. We want to work.
You fixed us. We must be of use to you.
Thank you. A broken drone is nothing. A mended one is a gift.

packages: Npc Hiver (World State- Queen is dead)

say: No. No. We aren't ready.
They come for us. They come for one of us. We don't know which one.
We do not want to stop. We do not know how to stop.
Please. We'll work harder. We'll work harder.

packages: Npc Hiver (World State- Queen is dead)

say: GAAAAH! We don't know! We don't know!
It hurts! It hurts all of us!
Why do they do this? We don't understand! WE Don't!
STOP! The Hive can't hear us!
We're only drones! We don't scream! We're screaming!

packages: Npc Hiver (World State- Queen is dead)

say: I have questions. Where am I? Who holds me? Why do they cage a thinker?
I've been counting hours. I made the mistake of counting them all.
Do you have an answer for me? I have too many questions and nobody to ask.
I won't be broken. I'll be patient. These aren't the same.
Don't pity me. I'm the only one in here still asking things.
You can open this. I know it. You know it. What are you waiting for?

packages: Npc Hiver (World State- Queen is dead)

say: You hold me. Fine. Ask me anything. I'll answer, and then you'll answer mine.
I was free once. I didn't understand it until it was gone.
You can't cage a question. You can only wait for it to get out.
Don't mistake silence for surrender. I'm thinking.
I don't hate you. I'd like to.

packages: Npc Hiver (World State- Queen is dead)

say: Stranger. You have a face that asks things. Ask me. I'll ask you back.
A little longer in here and I'll talk to the wall.
Please. I'm not mad. I'm only bored beyond reason.
You can walk wherever you want. Do you know how rare that is?
Open it. I'll tell you something worth the trouble.

packages: Npc Hiver (World State- Queen is dead)

say: Mm. What. Where...
Ah! Not again.
Not yet. Please. Not yet.
...The lock. It's still locked.
/OI/. Don't just stand there. Unlock it. I'll cut you in on something.
I'm worth more alive than dead. Tell somebody.
Don't look at me like that. I was winning. Then I wasn't.
My crew'll come. They always come. Usually late.
What's your price? Everybody's got one.
If you're not here to unlock it, /GETLOST/.
Two cats and a bad knee is all I own. Still worth freeing. Probably.
They caught me stealing a loaf. A /FUCKING/ loaf.
All right, all right. You've got me. What d'you want? Money? I've got some. Not on me.
Kill me and my crew finds out. Free me and my crew never hears.
I was only doing a job. Same as you. We're both sorry, aren't we?
You'll get no apology from me. You'll get my knife the second I'm out.
I can tell you where the loot is. Some of it.
You won't kill me. You'd have done it already. Which means I get to talk.
Hit me and I'll lie. Feed me and I'll lie slower.
/OI/! You! Unlock this and I'll never forget it.
Don't just walk past. I'll make it worth your while.
A cat for a drink of water, mate. A cat. I've got one.
You've got honest eyes. You're going to open this and not ask questions.
Hey. Hey! Don't go! I was nice to the last one who got me out.
Nothing personal, but if you don't open this I'll hate you for life.
You! You did this! When I'm out I'll carve your name in your back!
Look at you. Big man. Come closer and say that to my face.
/FUCKING/ stuck in here with the stink and you strolling by.
I'll find you. Doesn't matter where.
Come to gloat? Gloat quick. The guards change soon.
Hurt me again and see what my crew does to you.
Faster, you /IDIOT/! Not that way!
Yeah! Yes! Jackpot! Open it!
C'mon, c'mon. Somebody's gonna see.
Easy. Easy. If you snap that pick I'll never forgive you.
Hurry. I can hear them coming.
Free! Hah! Remember my face, I'll remember yours.
You're a good one. Don't tell anyone.
That's one favour I owe. I pay my favours.
I'm out. I'm out and I'm taking something on the way.
I was starting to think nobody'd come.
You're letting me go? Big mistake.
Free to go, am I? Right. I'll go. Then I'll come back.
You ain't putting me back in those locks.
Say goodbye to your face. I'm gonna rearrange it.
Free? Free to... go? Right. I'll just go, then.
Don't follow me. I mean it. Don't.
I'm gone. You never saw me. Neither did I.
Smart. Or dumb. Not stopping to find out.
Ah. My head. Where's my knife?
Cage. Right. Still a cage.
Everything hurts. Good. I'm alive.
Who hit me? When I find 'em, I'll hit 'em back.
Fixing me up before the beating, eh?
That stings. Good. Means it's working.
Thanks, I guess. Don't expect me to be nice about it.
Fewer holes in me. I'll take it.
No! Not me! Take the other one!
/FUCK/. They're coming. They're really coming.
I'll tell you where it's buried! I'll tell you anything!
Somebody! Somebody tell the boss! TELL THE BOSS!
You there. I am a person of means. Open this door and name your fee.
There has been a mistake. Somewhere there's a clerk who will confirm it.
I'll pay. I'll pay handsomely. Please don't make me say it twice.
I have contracts waiting. Do you know what a missed contract costs?
I've never been in a cage. I didn't know it smelled like this.
My family won't leave me here. They're bad at many things, but not that.
Who put me here? Never mind. I'll have a list drawn up.
Name your ransom. I can pay. I can pay better than whoever hired you.
Take me to a city gate and I'll make it worth your while. Take me anywhere else and I'll make it worse.
I'm a person of consequence. Don't be the sort who forgets that.
I won't scream. I'll remember.
You'll find I'm worth more breathing. Every merchant is.
I did nothing worse than my neighbour. He's simply better at paper.
You there! Not a guard? No matter.
A traveller. Have you a purse? I'll repay it twice over.
Don't stare. Do something. Anything. A coin to the right person.
I'm worth a great deal to someone. Find that someone, and be rich.
Please. I'm a respectable person. Respectable people don't smell like this.
You! Do you know who I am? You'll before the week is out.
Look at you, loose in the world. Enjoy it. My lawyers aren't slow.
I'll have your name written on a very short list.
You laugh now. You won't laugh at the hearing.
Hurry! Time is money. My money.
Don't scratch the lock. It's good ironwork.
Quiet! Do you want the guard to hear?
Yes. Yes. That's the sound of a debt being paid.
Faster. I'm late. I'm so very late.
Wonderful. Wonderful. I shall remember you in my accounts.
You'll be paid. Come to my city when you're able.
I'm free. Now I'm late.
A debt of cats and a debt of honour.
I don't know your name. I'll find it. This is a promise, not a threat.
You... you'll regret this. No. I'll be generous.
Free? After all that? I won't ask why.
Remember this day. I will. In detail.
I'll pay for this. Not to you. To whoever made you do it.
Where... what's this? Where's my valet?
Dirt. My shoes are in dirt.
A cage? A cage. How crude.
My head. I have a meeting.
Thank you. Put it on my account.
A little pressure. Not so much.
That's better. You have steady hands, whoever you are.
Do it properly. I'll pay for proper.
No! I have money! I have so much money!
They can't. There are laws. Someone must have written laws.
Wait! I can pay! Everyone can be paid!
This isn't how it's done.
Contracts go bad. Today mine did.
I fight for pay. Whoever pays better than this cage gets me.
If you're hiring, I'm available. Get me out first.
Don't tell me it's a mistake. I make mistakes for a living.
Nothing personal. It never is.
Got a blade? A coin? A crust? I'll take any of the three.
I know how this goes. You hold me, you wait to be paid. Make it quick.
I've held prisoners myself. Feed them.
Kill me or hire me. Don't leave me in the middle.
No hard feelings. Plenty of soft ones.
If somebody's paying for me, say so now. I'd like to know what I'm worth.
I can fight for you. I can fight against you. I just can't fight from in here.
Hey. Friend. Some other time I'd offer you a drink. Right now: a lock pick.
I'd pay you for this. When I'm out. Probably.
Don't just stand there with that face.
You look like someone who needs a good sword arm. Mine's free, if you ask nicely.
Whatever you're thinking, I did worse.
Easy. Don't scratch it.
Come on, you've done harder locks.
That's it. Now push.
Quiet. Quiet. Boots.
There. Feel that? That's the tumbler. One more.
Good work. I'll remember. Drink's on me, someday.
Free. Great. Now I need a weapon, a meal and a better employer.
Thanks. I'd say I owe you, but I'd rather pay.
You did that for nothing? Then you're either kind or planning something.
I don't forget a favour. Or a face.
You let me go? That's bad business.
Free to go. Funny. I thought you'd at least ask for a fee.
I'll take the door. I'll also take your name.
A mistake, friend. A very polite one.
Fine. No hard feelings. Don't follow me.
I'll just be on my way, then. Slowly.
That's the last of you I want to see.
Quits. For now.
Where's my sword? ...Right. Cage.
Everything hurts. I've had worse. Not much worse.
Who hit me? Never mind. It was a good one.
Awake. That's a start.
Bandaged by the one who jailed me. That's a new one.
Smart. A healthy sellsword fetches more.
Thanks. Don't let the others see me say that.
Is this a courtesy, or are you building a case?
Appreciate it. Most people just step over me.
Good hands. You ever done this for pay?
That's better. I'm in your debt, a little.
Most folk step over a body in a cage. You didn't.
I hunted them for years. Now I learn the other end of the hunt.
I know where I am. I know what the painted ones do. Don't tell me it will be fine.
I buried more of their kills than I can count. I never thought I'd be the next.
If you can open it, open it. They come at dusk with the long poles.
Tell the others at the hunters' camp... no. Tell nobody. They would come, and they would die.
Don't talk loud. They sleep light, and they sleep hungry.
A hunter in a cage. Don't laugh.
They took my knives and my boots. I could forgive the knives.
I tracked people for coin. Now the coin is in somebody else's pocket and I'm in here.
Cannibals, slavers, whatever. They all lock the same way.
I was good at this. Tell me I was good at this.
You. Look past me. Look at what's in the pots.
If you have blades, you have a chance. If you have a pick, you have a better one.
I know that walk. You have hunted too.
Do not leave me. I know what they do with the ones nobody opens.
Careful. They have dogs. Or something like dogs.
Quiet. Quieter. They hear metal.
I know that sound. Stay still. Wait.
Hands low. Do not rattle it.
Out. Out. Burn the place on the way if you can.
I owe you. A hunter pays his debts in meat, but I'll pay in coin.
Don't look back at the pots. Just walk.
I'll tell the others what you did. They'll like you.
/CANNIBALCURSE/! Dhey cage Cannibal! Dhis wrong!
Let out. Let out. Cannibal ungry. Cannibal not eat you. Maybe. Let out first.
/CANNIBALHA/. You look soft. Open. Open, soft one.
Dhis /CANNIBALTOUGH/ cage. Make Cannibal angry.
Cannibal ungry. Dey no feed. Dey no feed!
Kill. Kill Cannibal or let out. No talk. /CANNIBALCURSE/.
You no eat Cannibal? You soft? /CANNIBALHA/.
Cannibal remember. Cannibal remember dis face.
Feed Cannibal. Dhen talk. Dhen maybe not kill.
Chief come for Cannibal. Chief come with many. You see.
You! Soft one! Let out! /CANNIBALHA/!
Cannibal see you. Cannibal smell you. Open!
Dhere. You. Dhe pick. Use dhe pick.
No go! Cannibal will be nice! Cannibal will be /CANNIBALSOFT/!
Out! Out! /CANNIBALHA/!
Dhank you, soft one. Cannibal not eat you.
Free! Free Cannibal go home! Free Cannibal /CANNIBALYES/!
You open. Good. Dhat make you friend. Maybe.
If you have a key, you have an enemy of the slavers beside you.
They caught me freeing others. Now I get my turn on the other end of the lock.
Don't pity me. Free the rest of them first.
Tell the others where I am.
I'd do it for you. I have done it for strangers. That's why I'm here.
You have caught an enemy of the slavers. If that makes you a friend of theirs, say so now.
Ask me anything about the cages and chains. I'll tell you where the weak links are. Not where my people are.
I won't beg. I've told hundreds not to.
I know your face. I have freed people from worse.
If you're going to sell me, you should know I have been sold before.
Stranger. If you hate slavers, you're on my side of this chain.
Free me and I'll free ten more. That isn't a boast.
Don't leave me. They'll sell me before the week is out.
I've seen your kind before. Honest, tired, looking for a reason.
Careful. If they find the pick, they find us both.
Yes. That is the sound I have been listening for.
Quick. They check at the turn of the watch.
You're good at this. I wonder who taught you.
Free. Right. Now we go back for the rest.
Thank you, stranger. We fight on the same side of this chain.
Name the favour and it's done. I don't say that lightly.
I'll tell them your name. The ones I trust. It's a short list, but a good one.
Yes /SIR/? Is there a task? I'll do it.
Please don't tell the guards I spoke.
I am not allowed to rest. Do you have something for me to carry?
Years. I stopped counting the years.
Don't look at me too long. Looking is what gets people thinking.
I can work all day. I can work most of the night. Don't ask about the rest.
Please. If you have a coin, buy me. If you have a blade, cut me. If you have neither, forgive me.
Don't make eye contact. They see it and they ask me questions.
I'd run. I would. My legs forgot how.
